# 03.02.02-upgrade-sqlitepcl: Upgrade SQLitePCLRaw.lib.e_sqlite3 if patch exists

## Objective
Attempt to upgrade SQLitePCLRaw.lib.e_sqlite3 to a patched version while preserving net8 compatibility.

## Scope Inventory
- Projects: CarvedRock.Data, CarvedRock.Domain, any test projects referencing SQLitePCLRaw

## Done when
- Package bumped or decision documented if no safe patch exists.
